# Derived built-in styles reference

Covers character styles derived from implicit Code, Heading1 and BlockQuote
styles, alongside direct references to those built-ins. Enclosing direct font,
size, bold and italic remain unless the selected declaration chain supplies the
corresponding property. Implicit fallback formatting is not a declared inherited
property. A direct reference to implicit Code still supplies its font and size.

Visible content uses every fallback so the capture contains their declarations.
The model and all package parts are compared. Word review remains unreviewed.
